nodes.text: Made Me Stop favorites 🏆 Five photos that stopped my scroll. @i.m.doing.fine @whoissilver @annette7926 @citizenb @catmac720 - beautiful work, all of you.
photos: A stunning, oval-shaped turquoise lake is nestled in a vast, arid landscape under a dramatic blue sky filled with puffy white clouds. Distant rolling hills and mountains complete the breathtaking, remote view, making it a perfect spot for nature lovers and adventurers.
A vibrant red maple seed balances precariously on a delicate branch amidst backlit autumn leaves against a clear blue sky.
A young couple stands close together in a dimly lit art gallery, looking at an exhibit. In the background, another visitor in a long olive-green dress walks away toward an illuminated display.

A vast, icy glacier flows down from rugged, snow-dusted mountains into a calm body of water, with jagged blue ice filling the foreground. The dramatic landscape evokes a sense of awe, making it ideal for sharing outdoor adventures and travel experiences.

A vertical, slightly high-angle, long shot of Venice's Bridge of Sighs spanning a narrow canal at night. The bridge is illuminated from below and from the sides by unseen sources, highlighting its white stone arches and carvings against the dark, featureless night sky above it. The canal stretches from the center of the bottom edge toward the upper middle ground, ending at the bridge. The dark water of the canal reflects the lights of the bridge and the buildings, creating a shimmering path of light that extends from the bottom edge to the bridge. The canal is flanked on both sides by the weathered stone walls of tall buildings that rise from the water. The buildings on the left are a darker reddish-brown stone, while those on the right are a lighter grey stone. The windows are small and square, deeply recessed into the walls. The overall mood is quiet and atmospheric, with the warm light on the stone creating a sense of history and romance.

replies.text: Was the water really that turquoise? @i.m.doing.fine
Yes, the lake is known for its water changing from turquoise to deep blue with the seasons and weather conditions.
Such a cool place! Beautiful picture! Thanks for playing the game and for sharing the photo!
Thank you for your kind words 🫶
How long did you stand there watching it? @whoissilver
I took quite a few photos anyhow, also returned the following week for a different perspective.
photos: A close-up shot of a single, vibrant red maple seedpod perched atop a delicate stem, framed by a web of branches and autumn foliage. The background features a soft, golden bokeh created by sunlight filtering through the trees, evoking a warm, peaceful autumn morning.

replies.text: Did they notice you taking this? @annette7926
Thanks for the shout out! I watched them for a while before I took the photo. They were so sweet leaning into each other. Went up afterwards and showed them The photo and airdropped it to them.
My pleasure. What a sweet one. Thanks for sharing the story too. 👍
Were you on a boat when you took this? @citizenb
Yes, on a boat!
How late were you out for this one? @catmac720

nodes.snippet: Animal Thursday favorites 🏆 Five animals that stopped my sc…
nodes.text: Animal Thursday favorites 🏆 Five animals that stopped my scroll. @howard_83kg @special_ed04 @ahowardflfotos @eye.mac @empty_suit - beautiful work, all of you.
photos: A mother cheetah stands watch in tall dry grass while her two playful cubs interact with her, one standing up on its hind legs and the other resting near her feet.
Two dogs sprint dynamically across a snow-covered landscape, with a blue merle Australian Shepherd in the foreground showing an intense expression and a brown-and-white dog following closely behind.
Two majestic great egrets in full breeding plumage, with their delicate, lace-like feathers flared out in an elaborate display, stand amidst dark green foliage against a shadowy background.
A group of chickens stands in a dewy field at sunrise, illuminated by a warm, golden glow. The misty background features silhouetted trees, creating a peaceful, rustic farm scene.

A close-up vertical shot captures a shaggy brown bison grazing in a grassy field, its dark eye alert as it looks to the side. Behind it, another bison is partially visible, while the foreground is filled with dry, wispy grasses and soft green shoots.
A small, striped chipmunk is perched on a fallen log in a lush green forest, blending into its natural woodland habitat.

A high-angle, vertical shot captures an eastern box turtle nestled among the leaf litter on a hiking trail. The turtle has a dark, domed shell with striking yellow markings and bright orange-spotted legs, while its head features a distinctive red eye.

Two white-tailed deer stand alert in a frosty field of tall, dry grass. The morning sun illuminates the scene, catching the light frost on the vegetation as the deer turn to look directly toward the camera.
A white-tailed buck with large antlers peers out from a dense thicket of vibrant green foliage.

replies.text: Forest quartet.
How close were you when the cub reached up to mom? @howard_83kg
How long were you watching before the courtship display started? @ahowardflfotos
I think they were already at it when I arrived! That's what caught my attention. Thanks for sharing it!
Nice capture of the moment 👍
Are these your dogs? That Aussie looks like it's racing you. @special_ed04
Yes, they are mine. Scarlet is on the left and Quill is on the right. They love the snow!
So cool 👍
Did you lie down in the dew for that low angle? @eye.mac
How close did you get to this one? @empty_suit

nodes.snippet: Made Me Stop Friday 🛑 Show me the photo that made you stop.…
nodes.text: Made Me Stop Friday 🛑 Show me the photo that made you stop. The one that made you pull the car over, stop mid-walk, or just stare for a second too long. This rainbow over red trees did that to me. ONE photo. Replying is consent: 3 favorites featured tomorrow and pinned to the profile, and standouts may land in a weekend IG roundup with full credit.
photos: A vibrant rainbow cuts through a dramatic gray, cloudy sky, positioned just above a tree with striking red and green autumn leaves.
A tractor mows neat stripes into a lush green hillside on a bright, sunny day. Overhead, dramatic wispy white clouds stretch across a vibrant blue sky above a distant forest.
A straight-on, low-angle, eye-level shot looks down the dark center beneath a pier, its supporting posts illuminated in a warm orange hue, contrasting with the dark night sky populated with stars.

replies.text: Pier night. Did you wait for the stars to come out?

Stars are out at 4:00 am. The most difficult part of shooting stars is light contamination. The east cost is tough to shoot stars. That’s why I’m planning a trip next year to the southwest of America. Plenty of dark skies to capture star gazing.
Cool story. Have a great trip and get some great photos 👍

photos: A vertical high-angle shot depicts mountain ridges receding into the distance, with the highest range silhouetted against a pale yellow sky. In the foreground, a valley is filled with greenery and trees, all cast in a hazy, atmospheric light.

replies.text: Ridge haze.

photos: A single tree with pale bark and vibrant yellow-green leaves grows directly out of clear, turquoise water in a narrow, rocky canyon. Towering gray cliffs rise on either side, creating a secluded and natural landscape.

replies.text: Tree island.

photos: A vibrant red Amanita muscaria mushroom with characteristic white spots grows on the forest floor, surrounded by green moss, pine needles, and twigs.
A majestic eagle with dark plumage and white wing accents soars gracefully against a backdrop of a rugged, rocky mountain slope and sparse pine forests.

A vertical, eye-level shot captures a large, fluffy, cumulus cloud glowing with a warm yellow and peachy pink light, resembling a fiery explosion against a dusky gray sky. On the left edge, dark silhouettes of tree leaves frame the lower corner.

replies.text: Triple stop. Mushroom, eagle, or cloud — which stopped you first?
The Cloud!
The cloud it is 😆
Sorry, my englisch is very bad!🤷‍♀️🤭
No worries. Thank you for sharing the photos!

photos: Sunlight dapples the forest floor, covered in autumn leaves, as tall trees showcase vibrant fall foliage in shades of red, yellow, and green.

replies.text: Leaf light.
I was just dropping off and this Japanese Acer seed pod, backlit by the evening sun, caught my eye and I just had to get out and investigate.
photos: A close-up captures a bright red maple seed perched delicately on a twig amidst dark, backlit foliage against a clear blue sky. The golden hour light illuminates the translucent leaves, creating a warm, autumnal atmosphere.

replies.text: Seed pod. Was it the light or the shape that stopped you?
It was the pop of bright red in the tree which caught my eye. I was too far away to see the shape.
I like the nice color of fall. Good shot 👍
Stunning! Love the light on the red helicopter 🍁

photos: This vintage photo, captured through a window, shows the "Williams Boat Co" sign over a weathered dock filled with small boats, under autumn leaves.

replies.text: Boat Co.
Driving the coast highway in California… SO BEAUTIFUL
photos: A rolling landscape of green hills and dense forests is partially obscured by low-hanging clouds under a partly cloudy sky. Utility poles and a thin wire stretch across the foreground, suggesting a roadside view of the scenic countryside.

A lone red barn sits in a plowed field below a rolling, green hillside covered in scattered trees and a misty, overcast sky. Power lines and a wooden utility pole cut across the foreground, while a small white building is tucked away in the lower-left landscape.

A high-angle, wide shot shows a coastal view from a highway with a weathered metal guardrail and green grass in the foreground. In the background, the sea stretches out to meet the horizon under a clear blue sky, with large rock formations rising from the water near a sandy beach.

A storefront sign above a multi-paned glass window reads "ZAPATERIA" in bold lettering. Inside, wooden shelves display an assortment of brightly colored, whimsical clown shoes in hues of red, yellow, blue, and black.

replies.text: Clown shoes.
Scotland Eilen Donan Castle
photos: A large pile of tangled brown fishing rope rests on the grass next to stacks of green and blue lobster traps. In the background, Eilean Donan Castle stands on a small island in Loch Duich, surrounded by calm water and majestic Scottish mountains under a cloudy sky.

replies.text: Castle ropes. Did you get to the castle?
Yes, I got much closer for photos but our group did not tour the castle. This was my favorite photo from that stop.
Worth the stop.

photos: A large, weathered tree root sits prominently on a grassy field, with a striking tree displaying vibrant autumn colors directly behind it under a cloudy sky.

replies.text: Rooted autumn.

photos: A bright, double rainbow stretches across a gray, cloudy sky above a desert landscape with small trees and cacti. The low evening sun casts long shadows, illuminating the gravelly foreground of what appears to be a rural or suburban yard.

A bright, vibrant rainbow stretches horizontally across a wide blue sky filled with dramatic, heavy clouds. Below, a desert landscape features dry soil, sparse vegetation, prickly pear cacti, and scattered rural homes.

A vibrant rainbow stretches across a gray, overcast sky, its luminous colors contrasting sharply with the somber backdrop. Below, utility poles, overhead wires, and arid desert vegetation, including cacti and agave plants, silhouette against the light.

replies.text: Triple rainbow. Which desert sky was the best one?

photos: A squirrel climbs a textured tree trunk with a scenic waterfront park in the background. Across the sparkling water, a wooden boardwalk leads through lush green trees under a bright blue sky.

replies.text: Squirrel climb.

photos: A small hummingbird hovers in mid-air over a cluster of blooming purple wildflowers. The background shows dry, arid soil, suggesting a desert or arid environment.

replies.text: Oh, is that a hummingbird?
Yes, I was taking photos of the wildflowers and got a lucky addition .
They are so small and they move so fast! I am glad you have a shot! 👏
Bridge of Sighs, Venice. Kinda spooky feeling…
photos: A vertical, nighttime, medium shot shows the Bridge of Sighs in Venice, Italy, spanning a dark canal. The narrow body of water is framed by stone buildings on either side, with the illuminated bridge centered in the upper portion of the frame. The bridge's reflection shimmers on the water's surface, creating a long trail of light that leads toward the viewer.

replies.text: Spooky bridge. Did you hear anything crossing it?

photos: A vibrant sunset paints the sky in shades of orange and blue, with the sun just dipping below a silhouetted treeline. The entire scene is perfectly mirrored in the calm, reflective waters of a still body of water below.

replies.text: Mirror sunset.
Actually sunrise. Over a pond next to the Atlantic side of the island of St Kitts.
Aha, that reminds me, there are actually 2 golden hours in a day 🤭

photos: A small island with thin trees sits in the middle of a clear blue alpine lake, framed by tall evergreen trees in the foreground and a dense forest on the far shore.

replies.text: Island lake. Did you swim out to it?
Maybe in the past I would have..but now? Nah..I'm happy just to admire it😉
Admiring wins.

photos: An elderly woman sits on stone steps, knitting with yarn while surrounded by handmade dolls, colorful crafts, and her wares displayed for sale in a rustic village setting.

replies.text: Craft queen.

photos: A vibrant, turquoise blue alpine lake sits cradled within dry, rolling golden hills under a dramatic sky filled with scattered white cumulus clouds. Distant mountains stretch across the horizon, completing the serene wilderness landscape.

replies.text: Turquoise dream. Which lake is this?
It's Vražje jezero in Montenegro.
Vražje jezero. Adding it to the list.

photos: A vibrant rainbow arches across a dramatic, dark gray storm sky above a neighborhood of traditional brick homes with orange-tiled roofs and lush green trees.

replies.text: Roof rainbow.

photos: A wide-angle, low-angle shot captures a vibrant rainbow arcing over a vast, windswept moorland under a dramatic sky of dark, rolling clouds and patches of blue. The barren landscape is bathed in a warm, golden light, with patches of dry grass and low-lying vegetation stretching towards the horizon.

replies.text: Moor rainbow. Did you chase that light or did it find you?
We were driving towards Glencoe & we had to pull the car over to get this never to be seen again shot (yes I was standing in the middle of the road for the shot)
photos: A straight asphalt road stretches into the distance through a desolate, golden-brown moorland under a dramatic sky. A vibrant rainbow arcs across the clouds to the right of the road, creating a striking contrast against the moody, overcast weather.

replies.text: Worth the roadblock.

photos: A vibrant golden sunset beams through the tall pine trees, casting a warm glow over a serene lake. The tranquil water reflects the fading light while a paved path covered in fallen pine needles leads the eye toward the water's edge.

replies.text: Pine glow.
Napa, California
photos: A vibrant pink and orange sunset paints the sky with wispy, feather-like clouds above a suburban neighborhood. Silhouetted trees and the roof of a house frame the lower edges of the colorful evening scene.

replies.text: Napa glow. How long did the pink last?
About 15 minutes
I am glad that you capture it 👍
Me too- was white thrn pink then gone !
Love
photos: A young couple stands close together in a dimly lit museum, admiring art displays on a purple wall. In the background, another visitor in a long dress walks away, adding depth to the scene.

replies.text: Museum date. Were they looking at the art or each other?
Both !
Yesterday's Animal Thursday favorites are up too: https://www.threads.com/@saars.foto/post/DejvrXrG5gQ
Amalia Glacier
photos: A massive blue glacier flows down between dark mountain peaks, ending at the water's edge. Icebergs float in the gray water in the foreground, suggesting a cold, remote wilderness environment.

replies.text: Breath taking 👍

photos: A vibrant rainbow arcs across a dramatic, cloudy sky, casting a colorful glow over a calm body of water with a distant city skyline along the horizon.

replies.text: Rainbow encore.
Many thanks 😊
My pleasure.
